d.ko: "Hira Hira Hihiru" is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era. It tells the story of its two protagonists' struggle against Aerodema, a terrifying disease which brings the dead back to life.
d.en: "Hira Hira Hihiru" is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era. It tells the story of its two protagonists' struggle against Aerodema, a terrifying disease which brings the dead back to life.
d.zh:
《Hira Hira Hihiru》是以架空大正时代为背景的视觉小说游戏。
通过两位主角的视角，描绘了与“风腐症”这种“让人死而复生的疾病”作斗争的众生群像。
